title: Founding Platform Engineer
description: Northwind Robotics builds fleet-orchestration software for warehouse automation. As our founding platform engineer you will own the service layer end to end: the scheduling API, the simulation harness our customers run before a rollout, and the deploy path onto customer-managed clusters. Stack: Python (FastAPI), PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, Terraform. Must haves: 6+ years building and operating backend services; comfort owning infrastructure rather than handing it off; experience with a small team shipping without heavy process. Nice to have: robotics or real-time systems exposure. Based in or willing to relocate to Zurich; we work hybrid, three days on site.
